title: Modulated Global MLP
label: Modulated
short: Three tokens plus zero-initialized time/class modulation
question: Can direct time/class modulation improve the best Global MLP without removing its class token?
method: Retain three main feature vectors and the original Global MLP branches. Each block receives projected time plus class features and predicts independent scale/shift pairs for mixer and FFN. Zero-initialized modulation preserves the baseline initial output, weights and RNG consumption. No Q/K/V attention. The added parameters make this a larger-capacity comparison.
finding: 46 classes pass versus 42 for Global MLP, with mean SW1 improving to 0.03033; the best completed result at this stage, below the 60-class goal.
